figurative_meaning_en: Eating to satisfy one's hunger fully
similar_in_english: A full belly makes a happy heart
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজকের দিনে উদরপূর্তি না হলে কাজে মন বসবে না।
দরিদ্রের জন্য উদরপূর্তি সবচেয়ে বড় সুখ।
example_sentences_in_english: Without satisfying one's hunger today, I won't be able to focus on work.
For the poor, a full stomach is the greatest joy.
note: Often extended with the proverb 'উদরপূর্তি তো মন স্ফূর্তি' emphasizing that a full stomach leads to mental refreshment.
